Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
We are looking to hire a Sr. Product Manager I to join our Product Organization. You will be accountable for driving business impacting investments within areas of high ambiguity, driving strategy that aligns with customer demands, business goals, and industry trends. Join us and help our customers leverage the potential of their workforce and mobilize their talent. In this role you will focus on the Admin and Billing experience,  the capabilities enterprise IT teams, administrators, and billing owners rely on to manage users, licenses, access, governance, and their commercial relationship with Smartsheet.

You will report to our Director, Product Management located in our Boston, MA office. You may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

• Define a vision and strategy informed by company objectives, a deep understanding of customer needs, and industry best practices

• Partner with and influence technical and product leaders across Smartsheet to align strategy and platform investments

• Deeply understand how customers buy, provision, and manage their subscriptions, including plan and license entitlements, self-serve purchase and upgrade flows, renewals, invoicing, and usage visibility

• Work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Pricing and Packaging teams to position our Admin and Billing capabilities to IT and finance stakeholders, creating a strong go-to-market strategy

• Evaluate where AI can meaningfully improve the customer experience in new and existing features, making deliberate calls about how to apply it, how to earn administrator trust, and how to handle accuracy, transparency, and user control in workflows where precision matters

• Use AI tools to augment your own work (research synthesis, prototyping, analysis, and documentation) and identify opportunities to automate manual processes across the product development lifecycle

• Regularly present strategy, product concepts and roadmap to educate, influence and align with senior leadership

• Partner closely with research, design and engineering to create compelling, high-quality customer experiences

• Use internal and external data to guide experimentation, decisions, opportunities and evaluation of success

• Partner with research, product design, data science and analytics teams to run quantitative experiments and analysis to test hypotheses and iteratively develop product capabilities that our customers love

• Communicate strategy, product health, capabilities, experimentation status, and insights to a wide audience

• Write succinct and compelling product  strategy, execution and requirements documents

• Successful candidates will operate at both the strategic and tactical levels and form strong cross-team partnerships that ensure combined success for the product area

• Support other duties as needed

You Have:

• 5+ years of product management experience

• Experience partnering closely with engineering, design, user research and marketing teams. Successfully delivered a delightful user experience with high-scale platforms

• Passion to make customers and colleagues successful and pride in creating delightful customer experiences with high-scale platforms

• Data-driven mentality with a focus on metrics, analytics and experimentation

• Experience with agile development processes and frequent product releases

• Strong presentation skills to influence and align with senior management

• Experience delivering highly-complex consumer or B2B/enterprise software products from inception to launch

• Experience with agile development processes and frequent product releases

• Comfort using AI tools to augment your day-to-day work, and a bias toward automating manual and

• repetitive processes

• Sound judgment about when and how to incorporate AI into product features to enhance the customer

• experience, including recognizing where deterministic, predictable behavior serves the customer better

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• High interpersonal skills to build trusted and strategic cross-team partnerships rooted in customer benefit

• Technical degree, or equivalent experience working with engineers to make product decisions on behalf of customers

Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

• Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off

• US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans

• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

• Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave

• Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community

• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses

• Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account

• Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$148,750—$176,250 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

95c5d48abb999615.description: Key Responsibilities 1. Requirement Gathering & Documentation • Run requirement discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business needs and expected outcomes. • Prepare and maintain the BRD (Business Requirement Document), FRD (Functional Requirement Document) and PRD (Product Requirement Document). • Define user flows and screen behaviours so that design and engineering teams have clear, unambiguous inputs. • Conduct requirement walk-throughs with the client and the internal team, and capture clarifications and changes in writing. 2. Scope & Feasibility Management • Maintain strict product scope discipline: clearly separate what is in scope, out of scope and a change request. • Work with Sales to understand what was promised to the client and validate it against what the product can deliver. • Assess technical and product feasibility with Engineering and provide effort and timeline estimates. • Raise scope creep early and manage change requests through a formal process. 3. Delivery & Cross-Functional Management • Plan, track and deliver implementation of the product for clients on time and within scope. • Coordinate across Sales, Product, Design, Engineering, QA and Customer Success. • Run regular status meetings, sprint reviews and risk and dependency tracking. • Escalate blockers and keep leadership informed on progress, risks and delays. 4. Quality, UAT & Client Acceptance • Define clear acceptance criteria for each requirement, agreed with the client. • Write test scenarios for the QA team and make sure they cover the documented requirements. • Own the UAT (User Acceptance Testing) process: plan it, support the client through it, track issues and close them. • Obtain formal client sign-off on deliverables and UAT completion. 5. Adoption & Post-Release Support • Create DIY tutorials, guides and walkthrough material that help clients use the product on their own. • Run product adoption checks after go-live to confirm clients are using the features as intended. • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) on issues, delays and escalations, and drive corrective and preventive actions. • Feed client feedback and recurring gaps back into the product roadmap. 6. Stakeholder Management • Act as the primary point of contact for clients during implementation. • Set clear expectations, communicate proactively and build long-term trust. • Manage conflicting priorities between clients, Sales and internal teams with transparency. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • On-time and within-scope delivery of projects. • Quality of requirement documents and number of post-sign-off changes. • UAT turnaround time and first-pass acceptance rate. • Client satisfaction and product adoption rate after go-live. • Number of scope-related escalations and RCA closure rate. What We Offer • A high-ownership role at the centre of product and delivery. • Exposure to clients, product strategy and cross-functional leadership. • Learning and growth opportunities in a fast-moving SaaS company. • Competitive compensation as per experience and market standards.

About the Role:
Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.
We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.
This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.
As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.
What You Will Do
• 
Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.
• 
Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.
• 
Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.
• 
Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.
• 
Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.
• 
Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.
What You Will Bring to the Role
• 
Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.
• 
A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.
• 
Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.
• 
Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.
• 
Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.
• 
Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

About Karbon

Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List.

Are you a sales professional looking for an opportunity to make an impact in a rapidly growing, award winning and well-funded SaaS business that is disrupting a multibillion-dollar industry? 

We are always looking to connect with top-performing, self-starter sales executives who have the experience and drive to manage all aspects of the sales cycle — from prospecting and lead qualification to demand creation and closing new business.

While we may not have an active opening at this moment, we’re continuously building our pipeline of exceptional talent and would love to hear from you. When the right opportunity opens up, we move quickly — and we want to already know who you are.

Our sales team is based throughout the United Kingdom with the flexibility to work remotely. When positions do become available, they represent a tremendous career opportunity with strong professional and financial upside.

If this sounds like the kind of team you want to be part of, we’d encourage you to apply and introduce yourself.

About the Role

As a Sales Account Executive, you will be responsible for identifying and managing leads and opportunities, demonstrating Karbon’s value, communicating the compelling reason to change, and leading technical demonstrations of our platform while providing a first-class experience and ultimately optimizing how prospects run their firms. 

  • Respond to prospective customers promptly, book discovery calls with inbound leads, uncover their pain points, and tailor presentations to demonstrate how Karbon will help them modernize their firm, accelerate their growth and retain top talent
  • Drive and expand your portfolio of prospects through outbound engagement and call activity (~40% of appointments are generated by the rep)
  • Create Outreach sequences leveraging marketing rich content and/or custom campaigns that include phone, email, e-gifting, and LI to secure meetings with decision makers in ICP accounts
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities with a minimum of 3 times quota securing next step meetings throughout the process
  • Ensure accurate and timely updates of information and forecasts (call/meeting notes, supporting documentation, next steps etc.) in Salesforce/Gong
  • Demonstrate how Karbon's value proposition aligns with clients' requirements

About You!

We are looking for someone who thrives working independently in a high growth, fast-paced environment. The ability to multitask, leverage lots of modern software to automate tasks, set and adjust priorities, and be a team-player is critical. If you are hungry to learn and enjoy being a part of a high-performance team where authenticity and passion for action are valued, Karbon is your future home.

Candidates with the following qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply:

  • 3+ years of experience selling SaaS to mid-market businesses with a track record of being top performing and consistently exceeding quota
  • Experience with outbound sales; hunter mentality
  • Team player with a strong work ethic who is self-motivated and driven by results
  • Ability to demonstrate a strong business case for Karbon through a consultative and value driven sales process
  • The technical aptitude to master our sales tools /tech stack
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask sales opportunities of varying lengths and depths, and effectively articulate the potential you have with each account
  •  A friendly, but assertive demeanor
  • Bonus points if you have previous experience working at a company that sells Workflow, Accounting, or Project Management software 

Our sales team has amazing additional incentives focused on performance including an annual President’s Club Trip, Rep of Month, Quarter and Year!
